title: Preset system + Curl-Advection density baseline
purpose: Establish a visible volumetric baseline and a preset mechanism to drive parameters.

tasks.name: Add preset loader
tasks.desc: Load presets/preset.json by PLASMADX_PRESET, fallback to PlasmaBox defaults.
acceptance: Missing file uses defaults without crashing

tasks.name: Allocate ping-pong density textures
tasks.desc: Add secondary 3D texture + descriptors to DensityVolume; expose GetSRV/SetSRV for src/dst.
acceptance: Two textures created with identical dims/formats

tasks.name: Curl-advection compute shader & PSO
tasks.desc: Add shaders/vol/density_advect_curl.hlsl, root sig (SRV t0, UAV u0, constants), dispatch (dim+7)/8.
acceptance: Density changes over time with inject/decay

tasks.name: App integration
tasks.desc: Per-frame AdvectCurl when PLASMADX_USE_CURL=1 (default). Remove analytic fill steady-state.
